en: Sepia-toned vintage street view of a small European town square. Traditional multi-storey houses with steep tiled roofs line a curved street. In the background rises a baroque-style tower with a cupola and weather vane. Shop signs are visible on the buildings, including one reading "H. Badock". The printed captions on the image say "Pegau" at the top left and "Am Frankeplatz" at the top right, indicating the specific location within the town.
